Mockup

Not connected to anything. This is the full LocalNewsDatabase prototype dataset — all 2,103 outlets and all 8,561 coverage records, real values, nothing invented — carrying every feature of the Streamlit app: the metric tiles, keyword search, all three multi-select filters, the outlet cards, the coverage table and the data explorer. Everything runs client-side against one loaded payload (204KB gzipped), as the production widget would. Export opens a preview panel here because the artifact viewer blocks downloads; embedded in WordPress it saves a .csv. Whether the public embed shows all three tabs or only Browse is a config switch — the capability is preserved either way.
